Title: LBOL MP
Description: Coop mod for LBoL. Press F2 in the main menu to open the network menu. Host a session over Steam or over a direct IP connection, have other players join, then everyone start a new run, pick a character and click Confirm. The host sets the difficulty for everyone.
Brief: Co-op mod. Press F2 to open the multiplayer menu.

0.11.12:

Rumia event can only appear if everyone is above 40 P.

Implemented modlist check for content-adding mod mismatches.

Implemented exhibits in hand preview.

Implemented remaining missing card artwork.

0.11.6:

Tweaked the Ability Pile jade box a little bit to make it less brutal in Act 1/2.

0.11.3: 
Fixed missing localization on older Sideloader versions.

Fixed a softlock when trying to end your turn while previewing another player's hand.

0.10.5: 
Most visual card effects are now also visible to other players.

0.10.4: 
Defeated players can now see the enemy taking turns.
(This also fixes a potential desync at Seija)
Defeated players now play their death animations properly.

0.10.3: 
Reduced Moon Rabbit Duo HP scaling in multiplayer.

0.10.2: 
Fixed Rin's vengeful spirits dealing damage to clients when Rin was already defeated.

0.10.0:

0.9.9: 
Added 'SharedPartyPositions' config option (found in Bepinex config).
If enabled, every player (including you) is put in their 'actual' party position, instead of always showing the local player in front.
Defaults to false.

0.9.8: 
Raised the player lobby cap to 6 players. Anything above 4 players is not officially supported and may result in UI jank, but go nuts!

0.9.7: 
Added Japanese localization by neff.jp (thanks!)
Act 1 boss picks are now remembered in the save data when the run is reloaded.
Fixed Act 1 boss going missing sometimes.
Fixed some more Steam networking issues.
Fixed desynced combats in Act 3 if players choose differently at the Miyoi event.

0.9.6:

0.9.5: 
Moved ally player units around a little bit, to ensure player 4 no longer goes offscreen.
The F2 menu now always opens in the top-right to avoid accidental menu clicks.

0.9.4: 
Fixed Junko scaling up absurdly fast in multiplayer. Her overflowing blemishes and rainbow mana required are now scaled to playercount, and shared with all players.

0.9.3: 
Achievements and character records can now be earned in multiplayer.

0.9.2: 
Fixed players fighting completely different enemies at the same map node, especially when some players were newer and had not seen certain scripted encounters yet.

0.9.1: 
Fixed the map vote portraits not appearing, and sometimes being left behind on nodes nobody voted for, after using Restart Level or between acts.

0.9.0: 
Fixed desync issues caused by Steam networking.

0.8.9: 
You can now save & quit and continue a multiplayer run later. Everyone has to be continuing the same run for this to work (can't carry over singleplayer runs).
Returning to the main menu after winning/losing a run no longer requires disconnecting and reconnecting to start a new run.
The party status panel in combat is now hidden by default. Press F3 to show it.
Looking at another player's draw/discard/exile pile or library now shows their character portrait on the side, instead of yours.

0.8.8: 
Fixed a desync after using Restart Level.
More enemy defenses now scale with multiplayer health, including healing and barrier effects.
Fixed a desync caused by Cirno's Cold.
Fixed intermittent connection issues causing softlocks.

0.8.7: 
You can now look at another player's exact hand and game state by right-clicking them. You can also view their draw/discard/exile pile and their library in this state.
Fixed Midsummer Flowers tooltip.
Fixed occasional desync on enemies that summon or spellcard.

0.8.6: 
Fixed restarting level at the wrong time causing softlocks. Fixed minor damage desync, especially on Seija.

0.8.5: 
Enemies now get a 'Resilient' status effect in multiplayer. For each player past the first, an enemy loses 1 more Weak, Vulnerable, and Lock On at the end of its turn, and gains 1 less Firepower Down (minimum of 1).

0.8.4: 
Enemy health now scales up further in later acts, so 3 and 4 player groups aren't as easy. Each extra player adds a stacking bonus on top of the usual +100%, which grows per act. For example, the 2nd player adds +15% enemy HP to Act 3, the 3rd player adds another +30%.
Added a Balance settings window to the F2 lobby menu, letting you change the config settings more easily.
Fixed revival HP not being host-enforced.
Sanae's self-heal now scales with her multiplayer health.
Fixed a softlock in Doremy's Act 3 event when choosing the 'Search for Treasure' option.

0.8.3: 
Tenshi Hinanawi, Lovesick Girl and Sanae Kochiya are now scaled appropriately in multiplayer.
Border Sensor exhibit is now shared between players, so only 1 player has to complete the trade chain to access Act 4.
Fixed spell cards sometimes failing to trigger.
Restart Level in the pause menu can now only be used by the host, and restarts the level for everyone.
Fixed events in Act 2 and 3 offering every player the same exhibits.

0.8.2: 
Added Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese translations. Translations done by Lvalon (thanks!)
Major QoL tweaks to visuals and other effects to reduce jank.
Doremy's Barrier now scales with the amount of players.
Tweaked Eiki Shiki's fight. The mirror boss spawned by her is specific to you, meaning each player will be fighting their own mirror copy independently. Eiki Shiki herself is still shared.
When waiting for other players to end their turn, you can now press the 1, 2 or 3 keys to emote.

0.8.1: 
Fixed Great Tengu's Decree applying Block to everyone, instead of only the player who hit the enemy.

0.8.0: 
Reworked Act 1 boss selection. The host chooses the actual boss to fight, other players choose the character they want to get a shining exhibit from.
Added map vote indicators to show who wants to go where.

0.7.1: 
Seija's damage cap now scales with the number of players.
Enemy Graze and Wind God Girl is now increased by +1 for each player in the lobby.

0.7.0: 
Sessions can now be hosted over Steam instead of a direct IP connection. Use the steam overlay to join or invite friends!

0.6.1: 
Doremy's 'skip to the boss' event option is no longer offered in multiplayer.

0.6.0: 
Implemented automatic difficulty syncing. The host is the only one that can decide the game difficulty now, but players can still choose to enable/disable Requests for themselves.

0.5.0: 
Implemented event combats. People who didn't choose a combat option in an event will spectate the fight instead.

0.4.1: 
Fixed a bunch of RNG issues.

0.4.0: 
Enemy health now stays in step between players. Enemies that react to being hit, like the kedama's Fluffy, used to spend that reaction on a different attack on each screen and leave the enemy a few HP apart for the rest of the fight. The host's numbers are now authoritative and everyone else corrects towards them.

0.3.2: 
Fixed a stray status effect sweep that could strip Rin's summon mechanic off her on one player's screen.
Enemy starting max HP is now rolled identically for everyone, including summoned enemies.

0.3.1: 
Being defeated no longer immediately ends the run for the defeated player. Instead, you spectate the combat. If the party wins, you get healed for 20% Max HP but get a Regret added to your deck.

0.2.0: 
Fixed map voting getting stuck in many cases. Tweaked extra turn and end-of-turn behaviors.

0.1.0: 
Initial development build.
